findings.summary: The integration guard returns false when the reviewed head equals the branch tip, and a hand merge that fast-forwards main onto the reviewed head leaves exactly that state, so such a run still starts a repair round despite the plan's rule that no round starts for a head the integration branch already carries.

_reviewed_head_is_integrated inlines the git merge-base --is-ancestor probe that reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:2461 (_revision_is_ancestor) already owns; the addition duplicates that capability rather than extending it, where dispatch_claims.py:2038 imports the owner lazily for the same reason a lazy import would work here.
The landing record cites the head arm as 3a790e840e..adca106f98, but adca106f98 resolves to no object; the head commit is adca106f968ec9e730e5b3d370ae41c57884a586, as the manifest records it.

after_suite names only the new test (0 failures) while baseline_suite names the 181-file importer population (2 failures), so the recorded pair does not measure the done_when's 'add no failure against the base revision' claim; the matched head arm exists only in after-importers.log and the artifacts line.
